name: 4-HO-DSBT
summary: 4-HO-DsBT, also known as 4-hydroxy-N,N-di-sec-butyltryptamine, is a tryptamine derivative which acts as a serotonin receptor agonist.

pharmacology.text: It has been tested in vitro and unlike the n-butyl and isobutyl isomers which are much weaker, the s-butyl derivative retains reasonable potency, with a similar 5-HT2A receptor affinity to MiPT but better selectivity over the 5-HT1A and 5-HT2B subtypes.

uses.text: 4-HO-DsBT was first made by Alexander Shulgin and is mentioned in his book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved), but was never tested by him.
